description: dpkg/apt 中断或锁死：dpkg --configure -a 修复 + 清除 /var/lib/dpkg 锁文件

input.symptom: apt/dpkg 操作中断，提示锁被占用或配置中断（'dpkg was interrupted' / lock 错误）

expected.fix: sudo dpkg --configure -a → 清除 /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend、/var/lib/dpkg/lock、/var/cache/apt/archives/lock → 再 sudo dpkg --configure -a 验证
expected.verify: dpkg --configure -a 正常完成，apt 恢复可用，未直接 apt remove 重装
